decisions.final_content_text: Lead-acid battery charging behavior depends on state of charge and the charger or regulator strategy.

decisions.final_content_text: Under constant-voltage charging, a discharged lead-acid battery may initially accept high current, and charging current decreases as battery voltage rises toward full charge.
decisions.instructional_scope: Teach the trend and causal relationship only. Do not turn the statement into a fixed automotive amperage pass/fail rule.
